prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1281; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, we request that you provide a certified copy of the policy declarations page and disclose the applicable bodily injury and property damage limits, along with any other coverage that may apply to this loss.

We also ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data, recorded statements, claim notes, adjuster reports, and any repair or appraisal records. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or deleted while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written confirmation of receipt of this letter.
